metadata.name: Geochemical CLR measurements – LTp22‑1 (2022)
metadata.description: 41 sediment samples from core LTp22‑1 collected at a single point (21.277661 N, ‑104.690167 W, elevation 1430 m) on 2022‑04‑08. Each record includes depth (0–0.2 m), geological age (1866.7–2022.2 Ma), an age offset, and normalized elemental concentrations (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) expressed as CLR values (0–1), plus icoh/coh scatter, event identifier, and timestamp.
metadata.temporal: sub-second (all timestamps are identical midnight UTC)
